description: Points d'eau potable en Île-de-France (OpenStreetMap) is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by © Les contributeurs OpenStreetMap. Ce jeu de données recense les points d'eau potable accessibles en Île-de-France: fontaines à boire, fontaines Wallace, bornes de remplissage de gourdes, robinets d'eau potable, puits équipés de pompes, sources potables, bornes de distribution gros volume (camping-cars, navigation fluviale) et équipements publics délivrant de l'eau potable, notamment les fontaines adossées aux sanisettes publiques. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Cadre de vie - environnement. Its keywords are Eau potable, Point d'eau, Fontaine, Canicule. The portal shows 3,377 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
